logros.nombre: Wright Brothers True Master Pilot Award
logros.descripcion: Complete the game on Expert without ever losing a wing
Clear the game on Expert without wingmen completing any stage
Break 200 hits on Corneria and complete the stage
In Meteo get four plus4 combos in a row (hint R and Z prevents lock on)
Complete Sector Y on expert without taking damage
Get 120 hits before the boss using charged shot and bombs (no laser)
Destroy the mothership core with less than 3 seconds on the clock
Destroy Bio-Weapon, killing barnicles, with left and right side down as it dies
Finish Solar. Don't get any s. rings or let your life empty (star, g. rings ok)
Survive most of the stage above 7800 degrees  - vid guide available on game page
Play through Zoness in Cockpit view
Destroy all the missiles and complete the mission without any allies around
Get 280 kills in Area 06 Expert without using the charged laser or bombs
Collect 19 items in Area 6 ~(5 rings, 4 bombs, 6 gold rings, 6 lasers)
Reach the temple in Expert without killing an enemy
Destroy Golemech before 66 on the leaderboard. Hint- listen to Falco
Defeat all 4 Starwolf using single laser and getting plus50 combos from each
